name: OPLS-AA 2024 Lennard-Jones refits (CAPS refit, exp)
source: CAPS refits to liquid densities and heats of vaporisation at 298.15 K (NIST ThermoML / WebBook), with CAPS's own NPT MD (bench/ff/liquid_validate.py)

pairs.name: opls_753
pairs.comment: CAPS refit (exp): nitrile N (RCN) epsilon 0.17 -> 0.25 kcal/mol, sigma 3.20 A kept. Acetonitrile density +0.82 %, dHvap -0.12 kcal/mol; propionitrile -0.59 %, -0.15 (with the 2024 value: -3.21 % / -0.80 and -3.21 % / -0.83). Best of four trials (bench/ff/open/nitrile_lj, trial A)

notes: optional overlay on oplsaa2024.json (caps ff apply --overlay oplsaa2024-lj-refit.json, or with the rubber refits: --overlay oplsaa2024-rubber-refit.json,oplsaa2024-lj-refit.json); the base library keeps the 2024 values
